subject: Re: Technical check-in — trial integration calendar gap
body:
[Full email thread]

From: diego_fernandez <diego@redwood.com>
To: Alex Sullivan <alex.sullivan@stokes.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>, priyom_das <priyom@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-01T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Technical check-in — trial integration calendar gap

Hi Alex,

We had a 30-minute technical check-in scheduled today at 2:00 PM PT to walk through API key handoff and SDK bootstrap for your trial, but our meeting room was empty. I wanted to check in quickly and see if everything is okay on your side.

Quick summary of what we planned to cover:
- Confirm API key provisioning and least-privilege scopes
- Walk through Node + Python SDK initialization and sample request
- Debug the 401 you reported in the preflight log (attached)
- Agree on a follow-up plan and success criteria for completion of the trial POC

Attachments: stokesai-preflight-log.txt (logs you sent), redwood-onboarding-checklist.pdf (short checklist)

If something came up, no problem — tell me what works and I’ll rebook. Here are open slots on my calendar over the next two business days:
- Mon 10/04 10:00–10:30 PT
- Mon 10/04 15:30–16:00 PT
- Tue 10/05 09:00–09:30 PT

Alternatively, you can grab any available slot on my public link: https://calendly.com/redwood/technical-checkin-30m

Thanks,

Diego Fernandez
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

----- Reply (quoted below) -----

On Fri, Oct 1, 2026 at 2:47 PM, Alex Sullivan <alex.sullivan@stokes.ai> wrote:

> Hey Diego — so sorry about that. We had an emergency all-hands that ran long and I didn't get a chance to hop back in.
>
> 10/04 10:00 PT works for me. Can you confirm whether you'll need access to our staging service account or if we can just proceed using the API key you provide?
>
> Also curious if you can do a quick run of the Node SDK flow — our engineer (cc'ed) prefers Node.
>
> — Alex

----- End quoted reply -----

From: diego_fernandez <diego@redwood.com>
To: Alex Sullivan <alex.sullivan@stokes.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>, priyom_das <priyom@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-02T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Technical check-in — trial integration calendar gap

Thanks Alex — no worries.

We can proceed either way:
- Easiest: I provide a scoped trial API key from our sandbox environment and walk through the Node flow end-to-end without touching your staging credentials.
- If you prefer the end-to-end run against your staging, we'll need a temporary service-account key with read/write access to the test bucket and an IP allowlist entry for our test runner (I can send a minimal policy).

I’ve penciled in Mon 10/04 10:00 PT on my calendar for you. Confirm if that stays and I’ll send an invite with a short agenda. I’ll also include a short pre-run checklist so we can triage that 401 quickly.

Plan for the call:
1) Quick connectivity and key check (5 min)
2) Node SDK bootstrap and sample request (10 min)
3) Reproduce the 401 and inspect headers/logs (10 min)
4) Next steps: rollback plan and follow-up ticket (5 min)

Attachments: redwood-onboarding-checklist.pdf

Diego
